alternativas.feedback: Correto. The middle ear, or tympanic cavity, is an air-filled space in the temporal bone that is lined by a mucosa. Three auditory ossicles span the cavity between the tympanic membrane and an opening in the wall of the inner ear, the oval window. The middle ear communicates with the mastoid air cells posteriorly and with pharynx anteriorly through the auditory (Eustachian) tube.

Correto. The malleus, the first of the middle ear ossicles, is attached to the tympanic membrane and articulates with the incus. The auditory ossicles are covered by the mucosa that lines the middle ear cavity; tiny ligaments provide their support. Sound waves deflecting the tympanic membrane are converted into mechanical vibrations of the ossicles.
